question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Recalcitrant**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Among the given options, the word in option 2 is spelled incorrectly.**
 
• **The word 'Recalcitrant' is spelled incorrectly as 'Recalcitrent'.**
 
 
• The correct spelling of the word is 'Recalcitrant', which means stubborn or disobedient.(अड़ियल)
 
• Example: There is only so long the recalcitrant can stay.
 
 
 
• Other options in the question are correctly spelled words with their respective meanings.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
